title: oxicrypt-entropy raw-data dataset metadata
description: Sidecar metadata accompanying every raw-data collection. Records the collection environment (no anonymous datasets), the MEASURED counter frequency (never nominal), the injected min-entropy claim and health configuration, the sample count, and every health-test trip annotation observed during unfiltered characterization capture. Validated by the purpose-built subset validator in src/raw.rs; this is a draft-07-shaped document, not validated by a general JSON-Schema engine.

schema_version.description: Schema version tag. This schema is version 1.

sample_count.description: Number of one-byte samples in the accompanying raw-data file.

sample_width_bits.description: Declared sample width in bits (1..=8); effective emitted width is min(this, 8).

claimed_h_steps.description: Injected min-entropy claim per sample, in 1/256-bit fixed-point steps.

alpha_exp.description: Health-test false-positive probability exponent a in alpha = 2^-a (20..=40).

timer_source.description: Timer/counter the noise source read, or null for non-timer sources.

measured_counter_frequency_hz.description: MEASURED counter frequency in Hz (never the nominal SourceMetadata value), or null when no measurement was taken.

cpu_model.description: CPU model string of the collection environment.

os.description: Operating system of the collection environment.

collection_params.description: Free-form collection parameters sufficient to reproduce the dataset.

trips.description: Health-test trip annotations recorded during unfiltered characterization capture. Annotated, never dropped: no sample is removed from the emitted stream because of a trip.

sample_index.description: Zero-based index of the sample at which the test tripped.

value.description: The run-length (RCT) or windowed count (APT) at the trip.
